metadata.case_name: TSANG CHING FEI v. MO KING GUO

injuries.description: Fractures to the distal and proximal phalanges of the left big toe
source: The joint medical report of Dr. Chan Ping Keung and Dr. Lam Kwong Chin confirmed Mr. Tsang had suffered fractures to the distal and proximal phalanges of his left big toe.

manifestations.description: pin-prick pain over his left big toe provoked by prolonged walking of over one hour
stiffness of the inter-phalangeal joint (IPJ) of the left big toe with limited movement due to pain
numbness to the left knee down to his toe every night
permanent loss of earning capacity assessed at 2%

treatments_received: operation: open reduction, screw fixation and k-wire fixation
follow-up at North District Hospital until 28 September 2004
screw fixation removed on 16 July 2004 at the Ping Le Hospital in Shenzhen
treatments_future: consideration of fusion operation of the inter-phalangeal joint (recommended if persistent pain)

losses.description: Pain, stiffness, numbness, scar and limited movement of the left big toe resulting from fractures to the distal and proximal phalanges with a permanent 2% loss of earning capacity
